clips.title: The story
paras: In Tirisfal Glades, Scarlet Insignia Rings mark the Crusade's members. In Brill, the Forsaken collect them as proof that another zealot has fallen.

Every Scarlet Crusade fighter in Tirisfal Glades carries an insignia ring, from new neophytes and zealous friars to captains Melrache and Perrine. The Crusade's fiery sigil marks each ring, identifying members within an order consumed by paranoia. To outsiders, the rings identify Lordaeron's most fanatical human remnant.

Deathguard Burgess in Brill collects the rings under orders from Varimathras, Lady Sylvanas's dreadlord lieutenant. The Forsaken see the Scarlet Crusade as a pestilence across their newly claimed homeland. Recruits bring the rings back to Brill as proof of a Crusader's death and of their loyalty to the throne of the Undercity.
